saw_lines: Buyers pick bottled water by taste and habit, then reorder it by the case, so the first pack decides who returns.
So the first order is won or lost in the ad, when a new buyer decides whether to try you.
Your site offers 30% off new subscriptions, yet 0 of 20 ads mention it or any offer. Open three new ads with that offer on the creative and in the first line.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 30% off new subscriptions, yet 0 of 20 ads mention it or any offer, so a first-time buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with that offer on the creative and in the first line.

8 of 20 ads open on the same workout line, so the account repeats one story that buyers scroll past. Name two new angles from your product, such as pH9+ or sugar-free Activit, and test each against the workout opener.
Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 25 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has to click away to find the answer. Put the delivery answer in line one of new buyer ads.

Your site has subscribe and save, yet 0 of 25 ads mention a subscription, so buyers who reorder never see the option. Run two retention ads for past buyers, headlined with subscribe and save at 30% off.
